title: 2.2 Streets and Transport
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Name a street, a bridge, a bus, a car and a bike, and say what something is not: Es un autobús, no un carro.
grammar_function: Es un/una + noun; Es un X, no un/una Y.
speaking_outcome: Say what each thing is, and what it is not.
